reviews.text: Amazing girls who put me at ease from the very first moment of Madaleno's (my dog's) diagnosis. What a pleasure to find such professional and kind people 🤍
Very professional and nice. They are flexible with my minimal Spanish skills.
Wonderful service, they treat the animals with so much love. Super professional 🧡 …

Thank you so much MariaJose for sharing your positive experience at Clínica Veterinaria Ruzafa! We are confident that we will continue to meet your expectations and those of your pet on your next visit.

Today, a worker at this veterinary clinic treated me with considerable arrogance and rudeness. When working, one must have certain manners, especially when dealing with the public. However true what is said may be, the way it is said makes a big difference.

We went to the Ruzafa Veterinary Clinic seeking a second opinion after my dog, Furia, urinated almost black urine that morning. I was very worried, as she's 11 years old and a senior dog.

Veterinarian Vicky treated us with exceptional care and professionalism. She performed all the necessary tests on Furia to arrive at a clear diagnosis, explaining each step during the consultation and answering all my questions.

I've been to several veterinary clinics, but I've never received such excellent care as Vicky did.

I was looking for a veterinary clinic close to home, as we recently moved to the Ruzafa neighborhood, and they've definitely gained a new client.

We're very happy with everything. Thank you so much! 🫶🏼

Hello Sergei, 
We were delighted to see such a positive review, thank you so much. We hope to see you again very soon.

Ruzafa Veterinary Clinic
I urgently needed a prescription for medication the hospital had prescribed for my kitten, and the staff were incredibly kind and understanding. They did me a huge favor, thanks again :)
Excellent service. High-quality personal and professional service.
Accessible and dedicated veterinarians. Years of experience behind them

A few months ago, I started taking my dog ​​to this clinic, and honestly, we couldn't be happier with the way all the staff treat him.

Our biggest concern was having to have him anesthetized again, due to bad experiences in the past, but the professionalism of each of the veterinarians is simply outstanding. Since then, procedures like blood tests, vaccinations, and checkups have been incredibly easy and manageable for our dog, and for us, as they all have a remarkable ability to explain things very clearly.

Jeiko (who is getting a bit older) has never enjoyed being in a veterinary clinic; he usually experiences a lot of fear and anxiety. But he feels the empathy with which they treat him, examine him, and give him injections. And that helps him stay calmer.

Without a doubt, this is our new go-to clinic, and we wish we had discovered you sooner.
I highly recommend this place! My little Oreo is a regular client and they treat him exceptionally well.  Whether it’s for vaccinations or emergencies they’re always reliable.

Highly recommended veterinary clinic. The service is excellent, and they are always punctual for appointments. All the doctors who treated our kitten were very empathetic, clearly explaining her condition, and you can see they treat the animals with great dedication, care, and gentleness.

A clinic where you feel welcomed by wonderful veterinarians.
Friendliness and professionalism go hand in hand.
True focus on the patient.
Highly recommended and trustworthy.

We rescued a kitten from the street and couldn't get him to do his business 😊 He's a 3-week-old baby, and the whole team at this clinic took great care of him from the moment I called. The treatment was amazing and professional, so my baby and I have found the perfect place for us all to watch him grow up strong and healthy. Thank you, team! 🥰

Yesterday I took my dog ​​to the vet and, as always, the experience was excellent. They allowed us to wait inside the examination room so he wouldn't get stressed, a detail that was greatly appreciated and shows how attentive they are to animals.

The service is always impeccable: you can tell they work with true dedication, caring for each patient with so much love and commitment. It's very reassuring to know he's in such good hands. Highly recommended!
I couldn't be happier with the way the girls treat you; they are super professional and very loving with the animals.
They're the best!!

Terrible organization.
I had an appointment with my dog ​​today at a certain time. They called me to change the time to the morning, and when I arrived at the time they had finally told me, having been there early and waited to be seen, they refused to see me, justifying it by saying that it wasn't my assigned time. I reiterate that they informed me of the time change and confirmed the appointment by phone this very morning.

Whenever we go, the service is wonderful. We hardly ever have to wait, and they greet us promptly. They are very friendly, explain everything calmly and patiently, and have always found a solution to our needs. Highly recommended. Vicky is a true professional, and so are her colleagues.

Last month I spent a fortune on tests for my dog, and today I left a urine sample for analysis and paid €35. I often feel like they're more like salespeople than veterinarians, and that makes me lose confidence and consider changing vets.

From day one, they treated us and our little Felix like family. Seeing how they treat their animals, I recommend them 300%. They're attentive, and the affection the little ones receive is part of the treatment.
In addition to being good people, they're also good professionals. They've been able to treat any problem we've had right away, and they've run additional tests on their own initiative to be sure.
Don't hesitate to go there if you're looking for a trustworthy veterinary clinic.
I have nothing but words of gratitude for them, that's all I can say.

From the moment you walk through the door, you feel right at home. The love they show in their treatment of both the animals and the owners, especially those of us who are struggling as first-time pet parents, immediately reveals how professional and wonderful they are. They helped us immensely with our newest member of the family, who arrived traumatized and injured after the recent floods. Their willingness to waive the initial treatment fee, out of pure compassion for these animals, earns them a well-deserved 5 stars. Highly recommended, and we are incredibly grateful that there are still dedicated professionals who don't try to profit from our pets' health. Thank you so much.
